items.headline: PBOC shifts policy-rate anchor to overnight repo rate, discloses it at 1.25%
items.why: Structural change to China's rate-setting framework, a signal of scope for further easing that matters for China growth and risk appetite

items.headline: DeepSeek closes ~$16B funding round (~105.5B yuan) at ~$74B pre-money valuation; Tencent, Alibaba vie for stakes
items.why: Largest Chinese AI-lab raise to date; signals state/strategic capital backing China's frontier-model challenger to US labs

items.headline: OpenAI narrows new raise to ~$20B (from $30B target) at $1.25T valuation, led by UAE investors, ahead of 2027 IPO
items.why: Sets the benchmark private AI valuation and signals investor demand/capacity ahead of a planned IPO

items.headline: Samsung says its 2027 HBM output is already sold out, matching SK Hynix and Micron
items.why: Confirms AI memory shortage extends years out, supporting HBM pricing power and capex plans across chipmakers

items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: SK Hynix says DRAM/HBM production is effectively sold out through 2029 amid AI demand
items.why: Confirms multi-year AI memory shortage; bullish for HBM supplier pricing and margins, a key AI-capex bottleneck

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00% at October FOMC meeting; two officials dissent in favor of a hike
items.why: Signals the Fed is pausing amid elevated inflation, a key input to risk-asset and AI-capex financing costs

items.headline: PBOC injects record ~1 trillion yuan overnight liquidity, plus 700bn yuan MLF operation
items.why: Aggressive China liquidity easing supports China AI-equity complex (Alibaba, Tencent) and risk appetite

items.headline: Nvidia and AMD to invest $3B and $1B respectively in Meta's ~$25B equity raise funding AI data-center buildout
items.why: Chip suppliers backing their own largest customer's AI capex is a circularity signal investors are watching closely

items.headline: BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley arrange $63B financing to fund Anthropic's lease of Broadcom AI chips
items.why: Marks Wall Street directly underwriting AI infrastructure debt; validates Broadcom's custom XPU franchise against Nvidia

items.headline: AMD secures $20B+ commitment from Anthropic for MI450-based Helios AI systems, deliveries from 2027
items.why: Major proof point for AMD as a credible Nvidia alternative in frontier AI training/inference compute

items.headline: Anthropic publicly files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO (ticker ANT), targeting up to $2T valuation, listing eyed for Nov 12
items.why: Would be the largest-ever AI IPO and a key valuation benchmark for the whole private AI-lab cohort

items.headline: Meta announces $95B stock offering to fund AI infrastructure expansion
items.why: Confirms hyperscaler capex supercycle is accelerating, not plateauing, feeding chip and data-center demand

items.headline: Anthropic's S-1 discloses plans to spend up to $567B on compute, including building its own data centers
items.why: Quantifies the scale of compute commitments underpinning frontier-model economics and hyperscaler/neocloud demand
